ALTER TABLE payor_plan_item ADD CONSTRAINT ck_ppi_item_reference_by_type CHECK ( ( item_type = 'MEDICATION' AND brand_medication_id IS NOT NULL AND diagnostic_test_id IS NULL AND service_id IS NULL AND procedure_id IS NULL )
OR
( item_type IN ('LABORATORY', 'RADIOLOGY', 'PATHOLOGY') AND brand_medication_id IS NULL AND diagnostic_test_id IS NOT NULL AND service_id IS NULL AND procedure_id IS NULL )
OR
( item_type = 'SERVICE' AND brand_medication_id IS NULL AND diagnostic_test_id IS NULL AND service_id IS NOT NULL AND procedure_id IS NULL )
OR
( item_type = 'PROCEDURE' AND brand_medication_id IS NULL AND diagnostic_test_id IS NULL AND service_id IS NULL AND procedure_id IS NOT NULL ) ) NOT VALID;
